title: Fixator action on the stalk of a G-equivariant cosheaf
body_html:
Fixator action on the stalk

Let $V$ be a $G$-equivariant cosheaf on $X$ (G-equivariant sheaves and cosheaves) and $E \in X$ a cell.

Lemma. For each $k \in \Fix_G(E) = \{g : g\cdot E = E\}$, the $\mathscr C$-morphism $a^V_{k,E} : V_E \to V_{kE} = V_E$ is an endomorphism of $V_E$, and the map $$\rho^V_E : \Fix_G(E) \to \mathrm{End}_\mathscr C(V_E), \quad k \mapsto a^V_{k,E}$$ is a monoid homomorphism.

This is what Sheaf7 line 737-738 calls "$a^V_{g,E}$ induces a $\Fix_G(E)$-action on $V_E$" — the K-representation structure that the paper's Prop 2.7.2 restriction functor extracts from a $G$-equivariant cosheaf.
proof_html:
$\rho^V_E(k)$ is well-typed because $k\cdot E = E$ makes the target $V_{kE}$ propositionally equal to $V_E$ (bridged by an eqToHom in Lean). Multiplicativity is the multiplicativity axiom act_mul of the equivariant-cosheaf structure applied at the cell $E$, together with the eqToHom_naturality shifting act k at the propositionally-equal cells $l\cdot E$ and $E$. Sending $k = 1$ to the identity is the axiom act_one. $\square$

$K$-restricted variant

Given a $K$-cosheaf of subgroups $K$ on $X$ with $K_E \le \Fix_G(E)$ (the axiom K_le_fix of The transporter categories ]X/G[ and [X/G]'s input KData), composing with the inclusion $K_E \hookrightarrow \Fix_G(E)$ yields

$$\rho^V_{K,E} : K_E \to \mathrm{End}_\mathscr C(V_E),$$

the $K_E$-representation structure that appears as Condition (1) of Definition 2.7.1 in Sheaf7 (locator Sheaf7.tex §2.7, line 750-761).

Lean formalization

stalkHom W E k hk : W_E ⟶ W_E is the pointwise morphism, defined as (W.equiv.act k E).hom ≫ eqToHom(W_{kE} = W_E) using the hypothesis hk : k • E = E. stalkHom_one uses act_one directly. stalkHom_mul combines act_mul with a one-step eqToHom_naturality on the family b ↦ (W.equiv.act k b).hom plus a slice_lhs targeted rewrite. The proof structure is analogous to mapOfG_one in The transporter categories ]X/G[ and [X/G] but simpler because no $g^{-1}$ appears.

The monoid hom stalkAction W E : MulAction.stabilizer G E →* End (W_E) packages this as a mathlib MonoidHom (with End from CategoryTheory.Endomorphism, whose multiplication convention $x \cdot y := y \circ x$ aligns with the composition-order in the paper). The K-restricted variant kStalkAction κ W E : κ.K E →* End (W_E) composes with Subgroup.inclusion (κ.K_le_fix E).

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GCosheaf.stalkHom
lean_refs.signature:
def stalkHom (W : GCosheaf G X C) (E : X) (k : G) (hk : k • E = E) :
    W.base.obj (op E) ⟶ W.base.obj (op E) :=
  (W.equiv.act k E).hom ≫
    eqToHom (show W.base.obj (op (k • E)) = W.base.obj (op E) by rw [hk])

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GCosheaf.stalkHom_one
lean_refs.signature:
theorem stalkHom_one (W : GCosheaf G X C) (E : X) :
    stalkHom W E 1 (one_smul _ _) = 𝟙 (W.base.obj (op E))
lean_refs.docstring: **Identity of the stalk action**: the identity of `G` acts as `𝟙 W_E`.

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GCosheaf.stalkHom_mul
lean_refs.signature:
theorem stalkHom_mul (W : GCosheaf G X C) (E : X) (k l : G)
    (hk : k • E = E) (hl : l • E = E) :
    stalkHom W E (k * l) (by rw [mul_smul, hl, hk]) =
      stalkHom W E l hl ≫ stalkHom W E k hk

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GCosheaf.stalkAction
lean_refs.signature:
def stalkAction (W : GCosheaf G X C) (E : X) :
    MulAction.stabilizer G E →* End (W.base.obj (op E)) where
  toFun k := stalkHom W E k.val k.property
  map_one' := stalkHom_one W E
  map_mul' k l := stalkHom_mul W E k.val l.val k.property l.property
lean_refs.docstring: **The stalk action as a monoid homomorphism**.

lean_refs.name: SheafOnBuilding.GCosheaf.kStalkAction
lean_refs.signature:
def kStalkAction {G' : Subgroup G} {S : Subcomplex X}
    (κ : KData G' S) (W : GCosheaf G X C) (E : X) :
    κ.K E →* End (W.base.obj (op E)) :=
  (stalkAction W E).comp (Subgroup.inclusion (κ.K_le_fix E))
